svg.text: Axonometric · Building 1 · No Elevator · LOT A (west side of the street)
Lot 10 m × 20 m = 200 m² · front setback 4 m · 3 m floor-to-floor
AXONOMETRIC — TASK 1 — NO ELEVATOR (4 FLOORS, MAX AREA)
LOT A (west side of the street) · 1:200 plan-oblique axonometric (plan rotated 30°/60°, all horizontal and vertical dimensions true length)
Without an elevator the building is limited to 4 floors.
Any smaller footprint would lose floor area, so
70% coverage is as low as it can go.
